doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Short films Blues in the Night and Choo Choo Swing
summary: Brown mentions Young's film shorts; Young does not recall Choo Choo Swing with Basie.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Uh huh, okay. So you made a couple of films, one in nineteen, you made some films, a short film; 1941 with Jimmie Lunceford called Blues in the Night.
Yes. Brown:…and then you also made another film with Basie called Choo Choo Swing.
Choo Choo Swing…Choo Choo Swing, or Band Parade.
I‘m not understanding that word you‘re saying.
I don‘t remember that at all…
That‘s okay, that‘s alright. And then, according to this, that was in 1943. That was with Basie‘s band, Choo Choo Swing, made a film, short film.
Choo Choo Swing was with Basie, you said?

Yeah, it was a short film, that‘s why I don‘t remember it. Yeah, Choo Choo Swing probably was. Okay…I didn‘t think it was with Lunceford. Choo Choo Swing, I was with Basie when I was recording thing. Yeah. Choo Choo Swing, that‘s a funny thing, I don‘t remember that at all. Did somebody sing on it or something?
